description: This is a false-colour satellite image displaying a predominantly forested landscape. Extensive areas of dense vegetation, likely coniferous forest as described in the accompanying text (EUNIS G3), appear as dark purplish-red. Within these forested zones, thin, winding white or light grey linear features are visible, which are consistent with forest tracks or unpaved roads. Areas with sparser vegetation, clear-cuts, or stages of forest regrowth are distinguishable by a brighter red or magenta colour. In the upper-left quadrant, a distinct smaller area exhibits blue/cyan and white features, indicating urban or built-up structures adjacent to the forest. The image lacks a scale bar, compass, or specific date.
